item.title: One person dead after house fire in south Lincoln
item.description: LINCOLN, Neb. (KLKN) — Lincoln Fire & Rescue said one person has died after a house fire at South 11th and Van Dorn streets Friday morning. item.description: LINCOLN, Neb. (KLKN) – The 2026 state semifinals concluded Friday night after a loaded day of basketball. In Class C1, Milford took on Gothenburg.
